versions.changelog: Add runtime dependency checks, bundled verification, README quick start, and source repository publication.

Version 1.0.1

- Added comprehensive real-world examples and quick start commands to documentation.
- Expanded built-in template catalog and listed template details (name, fonts, primary color).
- Improved and clarified workflow steps for document conversion and formatting.
- Updated requirements and safety notes for clarity.
- Added sample input/output scenarios to showcase document types and formatting outputs.
- Cleaned up file organization by adding sample examples and removing deprecated/duplicate files.

doc-weaver 1.0.0

- Initial release: Transform Markdown or outline files into publication-ready Word (.docx) or PDF documents with built-in professional templates.
- Auto-detects document type (PRD, report, thesis, manual, contract) and applies matching style.
- Supports advanced formatting: heading numbering, table of contents, tables, code blocks, blockquotes, images with captions, and styled headers/footers.
- Exports directly to .docx and to .pdf via Pandoc or md-to-pdf.
- All processing is local; supports custom CSS for PDF styling.
- Includes sample command-line prompts and batch conversion.
